+from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
+from rich.text import Text
+
+def test_url_with_at_symbol():
+    highlighter = ReprHighlighter()
+    text = Text("Check out https://user:pass@example.com")
+    highlighter.highlight(text)
+    
+    print(f"Spans: {text.spans}")
+    
+    url_span = next((span for span in text.spans if span.style == "repr.url"), None)
+    
+    assert url_span is not None, "URL with '@' was not highlighted"
+    assert text.plain[url_span.start:url_span.end] == "https://user:pass@example.com"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_url_with_at_symbol()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
